notes: EXCLUDED FROM THE TRAINING SET. The measured analyte is TIGECYCLINE, a tetracycline antibiotic - the paper introduces it as 'Tigecycline (TGC), a new-generation tetracycline antibiotic' - loaded into Tween-80-coated chitosan nanoparticles that display an amyloid-beta fragment as a brain-targeting ligand. The paper's own three-arm comparison settles the attribution: the SAME drug has a half-life of 0.77 h free, 0.91 h in plain chitosan nanoparticles and 1.26 h in the targeted ones. PEPlife2 files the 1.26 h value against the sequence CGSNKGAIIGLM, whose own concentration is never measured. PEPlife2 ID 4037 dropped via CURATED_NOT_A_HALF_LIFE.
